name: Apple for Teacher: A Yandere Love Short
source:
Ciel, your TA and unwanted tutor, wants to take you out to celebrate passing his class. Unfortunately for you, you'll never make it to that fancy restaurant.

After all, he has plans for you...

[From [url=https://ataraxicgames.itch.io/yandere-love-apple-for-teacher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Ciel既是你的助教，也是你并不想要的辅导老师。为了庆祝你通过他的课程，他想带你出去吃饭。遗憾的是，你永远到不了那家高级餐厅。

毕竟，他早已替你安排好了一切……
